Description: As an Investment Associate, I want to define a thesis metric with unit, target, period and source so that it can be monitored after approval.
As an IC approver, I want to freeze the approved thesis version so that later monitoring uses the decision-time assumptions.
Map actual portfolio data to thesis metrics
As Operations, I want to map a thesis metric to a governed source field so that actuals load consistently.
As Operations, I want invalid or duplicate observations quarantined so that portfolio metrics remain trustworthy.
As a Portfolio Manager, I want target and actual variance calculated by period so that I can understand deviation.
As Product Operations, I want severity thresholds by metric so that material exceptions are prioritized.
Turn material variance into accountable action
As a Portfolio Manager, I want a material breach to create an exception with context so that I know what needs review.
As a Portfolio Manager, I want to assign an exception and due date so that investigation is accountable.
As an owner, I want to document cause, action and resolution so that the decision history is retained.
As a Portfolio Manager, I want investments sorted by material exception so that I allocate attention efficiently.
As an IC member, I want to see original and revised thesis versions so that changes remain transparent.
